title: Investigations of heavy p-block elements (Sn, Sb, Bi) in 2-amino-5-methylpyridinium halogenometallate complexes: optical absorption and electrical properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25348-25364
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02081J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mohamed Loucif, Iheb Garoui, Souad Chkoundali, Rima Mohammed Altalib, Mehdi Akermi, Abderrazek Oueslati
The interaction between 2-amino-5-methylpyridinium and heavy p-block metal chlorides (Sn, Sb, and Bi) results in the formation of three hybrid compounds: (C6H9N2)2SnCl6, (C6H9N2)3[BiCl6], and (C6H9N2)2[Sb2Cl8].
